open_issues: HOST STABILITY (medium, not fully root-caused): during the host runs the process exited by itself twice, several minutes into a session, once within ~60s of opening W12 — with an empty host log, no Windows Application-Error event and no stderr. A later 70s run on W12 survived, so it is not deterministic on W12. The most likely shape is an exception escaping a background pass (ReminderScheduler's minute tick or ClockGuard's re-check) through the renderer's dispatcher, which in a BlazorWebView tears the app down. I hardened what is mine: MainLayout's BackgroundPassDispatcher now catches everything a pass throws, so a failed pass can no longer take the window down. If the exits continue, the fault is inside ReminderScheduler/BadgeService/HealthService (Wakeel.Core) or the Windows probes in Wakeel.Desktop/Services — both outside this package's allowed edits.

W11 could not be shown in the host: raising Banner.Clock needs the machine clock to actually fail its check, which would mean changing this computer's Windows date-and-time. W11 is covered by six bUnit tests instead (hidden with a healthy clock, shown with a bad one including the numbering notice, both buttons' tooltips, «تجاهل مؤقتًا» hiding the banner while numbering stays blocked, and «تصحيح الساعة» calling ISystemSettingsLauncher exactly once).

ReadinessService does not exist yet (it is package B5's). W08's monthly-report banner therefore shows the financial-cycle sentence with 0% and «لم تُحسب بنود الجاهزية بعد» instead of the preview's «الجاهزية 80 بالمئة / 8 من 10 بنود مكتملة». The spec allows this («بيانات حقيقية من ReadinessService إن وُجدت أو 0 مؤقتًا»).

Three W08 links point at screens later packages build: «فتح التقرير الشهري» -> /w70, «التقويم» -> /w39, «عرض كل المصروفات» -> /w66; W10's «الإعدادات» -> /w86 and every record route in RecordRoutes.cs are the same. Until those pages exist, following one lands on the router's «الصفحة غير موجودة». (The previous attempt had the monthly report pointing at /w75, which is the sync centre; corrected to /w70.)

I extended four existing Wakeel.Design components beyond the literal allowance (WKpiCard: OnClick/Tooltip/Variant/Class; WSegmented: Icons/Stacked/Class; WDialog: Notice/Inline/Class/MaxWidthPx; and a title on WDialog's close cross). Every change is additive — no existing caller's markup or behaviour changes — and each was needed to stop a screen hand-rolling a control, which the owner's design-consistency rule forbids. Flagging it so a reviewer can confirm the scope call.

W09's tabs are the product's WTabs (underline) while the W09 export draws pill tabs; W09 also has no pager, no «تصفية» and no «الأكثر تأخرًا أولاً» sort, and no «تصدير القائمة» — none of those are in the B2 specification. Accepted deviations, listed in the comparison table below.
W94's task section asks for «المكلّف (اختياري)» where the export shows «الربط بمراسلة (اختياري)»: linking to a correspondence needs the correspondence package (B3) to exist first.
notes:
WHAT WAS ALREADY THERE AND WHAT I ADDED
The previous attempt had left all eight screens, ShellServices/PhoneExpenseReview/Ar.Shell.cs and the MainLayout wiring on disk but its progress file only recorded the first three steps. I verified the shell wiring (ClockGuard + ReminderScheduler started on sign-in/unlock with ComponentBase.InvokeAsync as the BackgroundPassDispatcher and stopped on lock/sign-out, badge subscription, bell, Ctrl+N) and then did the work that was actually missing: the design-consistency pass, all the tests, the two carry-over findings and the host run.

TWO REAL BUGS THE NEW TESTS AND THE HOST RUN FOUND
1. PhoneExpenseReview.ConfirmAsync stamped the expense (Status/DecidedAt/TransactionId) BEFORE saving the transaction it points at, so the UPDATE and the INSERT it depends on went to SQLite in one batch and «تأكيد» failed on a foreign key every single time — item 50 was broken end to end. The expense is now stamped in a third save after the transaction and its ledger lines, inside the same database transaction.
2. PageHeaderState.Clear() in a page's Dispose wiped the header the INCOMING page had just published, because routing initialises the new page before disposing the old one: every screen reached by navigation lost its title row. Set() now records the publishing component and Clear(owner) is a no-op once someone else owns the header. Both were seen live (the second one in the W91/W92 screenshots).

DESIGN-CONSISTENCY PASS (owner's rule of 2026-09-16)
Four hand-rolled controls were replaced by design components, three of which had to be added or extended first — component + css + gallery entry + bUnit test each:
- NEW WNotificationPanel (the 380 px panel chrome: head with count badge, tabs slot, scrolling list, footer) and NEW WNotificationItem (unread dot, kind + relative time, title, body, icon square, semantic tint). W10 had hand-rolled the whole panel and every row.
- WSegmented gained Icons + Stacked, so W94's five kinds are the design system's segmented strip instead of a hand-rolled role="tablist".
- WDialog gained Notice (the dark consequence strip the exports show) and Inline (the surface drawn in the page). W92's five reference cards ARE real WDialog surfaces now, so the sheet can never show a shape the product does not use; its extra «triggers» strip, which the preview has no trace of, was removed.
- WKpiCard gained OnClick/Tooltip/Variant, so W08's KPI card is the component's own button rather than a raw <button> wrapper, and its number carries the semantic colour the export shows.
- W08's meetings became WKvRow, and its sync/backup cards became WKvRow + WChip instead of one sentence each.

PER-SCREEN SIDE-BY-SIDE (host screenshot at 1366x768, DPI 1.25, beside design/exports/preview/light/W)
W08 مركز الانتباه — side column was on the START side, preview has it on the END -> FIXED (main column first). Section title wrapped over three lines and the search fell to its own row -> FIXED (title nowrap, tabs+search share the header row). Seven tabs vs the preview's four -> FIXED (four; cases/decisions/expenses stay inside «الكل» and each has its own list elsewhere). KPI numbers were all one colour -> FIXED (danger/warning). Meetings had the hour at the start -> FIXED (WKvRow, hour at the end, as drawn). Sync/backup were one sentence -> FIXED (field/value rows with a status chip). «عرض كل المصروفات» and «التقويم» links were missing -> ADDED. Monthly-report route was /w75 (the sync centre) -> FIXED to /w70. REMAINING: readiness shows 0% / «لم تُحسب بنود الجاهزية بعد» (accepted, B5 owns ReadinessService); the local search still wraps under the tabs at this DPI (low, width-driven).
W09 المتأخر — columns, chips, semantic due colour, days-late, next step and «معالجة» all in the preview's places. Primary header button said «معالجة» -> FIXED to «معالجة التالي». ACCEPTED: WTabs underline instead of the export's pill tabs (one tab component in the product); no pager, no sort control, no «تصدير القائمة» (none are in the B2 spec); the seven-column table shows a horizontal scrollbar at this width (low).
